## Summary

```text
source particle rules → BackgroundParticles / MainBackground
local SWF             → numeric gradient import
rendering / stage / world wiring → separate follow-up
```

Recover the retained background state and paint parameters before replacing the current rendering approximation. Preserve the source's preceding-count overfill, linked insertion/removal, per-frame parallax and forced efficiency latch. Stacked above #36; the observed nonpainting-mask correction remains intact.

## Evidence

- **Before:** shared source particle state and its numerical paint data are not represented.
  **After:** eight source-contract tests preserve first-update20 visits, counter5/10 emission, last painted dead-head pixels, no wrapping, draw/insertion order, duplicate BB/transparent alpha arms, pruning short-circuit, parallax and forced Efficiency Off resume.
- Formatting, TypeScript,462 rule/parser tests /5813 assertions and production build pass. Stage/world integration tests and browser flows belong with the upcoming wiring; this slice changes no visible browser flow.
- Independent AS/pcode audit found no ordinary-path mismatch. Main constructs two identically configured layers with separate random draws; parent opacity and bitmap composition follow in the renderer slice.
- Two imports are identical and match backlog data (SHA256 ac7ec6aa5b528c3aa0890ed35bc431f8db7681c4b65d2224f98b30ef53e3deff). Independent FFDec SVG metadata agrees on bounds, all stops and the gradient matrix at its exported four decimals. Full raw precision is retained. Only numerical facts are committed, with no paths/media/SWF.
- Global RNG interleaving, ENTER_FRAME phases, bitmap/channel rounding, Freeze color changes and renderer/runtime parity remain open. Optional cluster/burst APIs and external motion vectors are omitted; no activating callers/writes were found in the inspected decompiled tree, a bounded finding. Complete background/menu/game parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** model

Adds an unused model/import and source-backed tests. Land #36 first, then connect the shared stage, camera deltas, pause/efficiency and native/mock painting in a separate PR.
